title: Client Brief
description: Structured client data used by onboard-client.mjs to populate Sanity and generate AI-HANDOFF.md.

trade.description: Trade pack used to seed default content — must match a pack in studio/scripts/trade-packs (e.g. 'plumber', 'electrician'). The SEED_TRADE env var overrides this for the seed; if neither is set it defaults to 'plumber'.

shortDescription.description: One-liner — e.g. 'Painter and decorator covering South Manchester'

description.description: Longer company description for structured data (optional)

phone.description: Primary business phone — becomes canonical NAP phone

whatsappNumber.description: International format without + — e.g. '447700000000'. Leave blank to hide WhatsApp button.

differentiators.description: 2-4 things that GENUINELY set this client apart (e.g. 'family-run since 1998', 'all engineers DBS-checked', 'free thermal-imaging leak survey'). The copy generator uses these to keep every client's site unique + true — two same-trade clients only diverge on real facts, so this is required raw material, not fluff. Use ONLY true, client-confirmed claims.

yearsTrading.description: e.g. '15' — only if accurate; used for 'established' framing.

address.description: Leave empty {} if service-area-only business (no public address).

social.description: Full profile URLs — Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, etc.

trust.description: Powers the Trust Bar blocks (settings.trust). Leave any part out to hide it. UK law (DMCC Act 2024) treats fake credentials as illegal — only enter claims that are true and verifiable. ('As featured in' press logos need an image upload, so add those in Studio.)

stat.description: Headline trust stat shown in the trust bar.

sub.description: e.g. '13+ years · Gas Safe registered · 2,000+ jobs'

accreditations.description: Certifications / accreditations the business genuinely holds.

icon.description: Trust icon (defaults to ShieldCheck if omitted or off-list)

reviews.description: Structured review data (settings.structuredData.reviews) + the review-cells trust bar. DMCC Act 2024: only enable with REAL, publicly visible reviews — fabricated ratings are illegal. Default: disabled, so onboard never writes a rating unless you opt in.

enabled.description: Enable the reviews schema + review-cells trust bar. Only true if the reviews are genuinely visible on the site and real.

aggregate.description: Aggregate rating — only written when enabled AND reviewCount > 0. Use real, verifiable numbers.

reviewCount.description: Real number of reviews behind the rating

platforms.description: Per-platform ratings for the review-cells trust bar (written only when enabled). Only add platforms with real, publicly visible reviews.

keyword.description: The real PRIMARY SEARCH term for this service (what people actually type) — e.g. 'bathroom renovation', NOT the marketing name 'Luxury Bathroom Design & Renovation'. Becomes the page's gated H1 keyword AND the DataForSEO suggestion seed. Leave blank to fall back to the service name (often a zero-volume term).

details.description: The real specifics the client confirmed about THIS service — what's included, brands fitted, process, typical jobs, any genuine guarantee. This is the ONLY pool of facts the copy generator may state about the service; it must not invent accreditations, prices, warranties, response times or stats beyond what's written here + the trust block.

keyword.description: Optional override for the area page's primary keyword (default '<trade> <area>', which is usually already searchable).

openingHours.description: If set, creates openingHours on LocalBusiness. Format: 'Mo-Fr 08:00-17:00'

serviceAreaOnly.description: True if business has no public address (SAB). Skips address + geo in LocalBusiness.
